Method of Attack: Disguised as harmless lifestyle apps (Yoga companion app, Kakao Talk messaging app, image gallery browser, photo editing tool)
Steals sensitive information including installed apps list, SMS, contacts, call logs, images, device info (IMEI, brand, device name, Android version)
Installs apps by downloading APKs from C2 links
Steals credentials using phishing URLs mimicking Facebook, Instagram, Kakao, Google login portals
Records audio and video in real-time using front and rear cameras
Conceals presence by hiding app icon
Impacted Systems: Android devices used by South Korean users
Attack Vector: Installation of disguised spyware-laced apps from unknown sources (websites, obscure APK stores, social media, forums, webhards, torrents)
Potential SMS messages sent from compromised devices to contacts with download links
